objective: Classify all twelve minimum four-state 5x3-k3 same-exact-rank affine-XOR contradiction certificates before introducing interaction terms.
method: Emit full rows for every size-4 contradiction certificate.
For each four-row certificate, evaluate all three perfect pairings.
Choose the pairing with the smallest nonempty component-parity symmetric-difference as the local substitution candidate; retain ties explicitly.
Record the two common component contexts and the outcome-code delta induced by the same substitution in each context.
Group rectangles by substitution signature and by context-effect pattern.
decision_questions: Do all minimal rectangles share one substitution signature?
If not, how many distinct substitution generators occur?
Does a repeated substitution change effect only under one recurring context factor?
Is a pairwise-interaction model now warranted, or is broader nonlinear structure indicated?
anti_circularity: No new feature is fit to values.
Pairing is selected by structural symmetric-difference size, not by outcome labels.
All outcome comparisons occur after certificate structure is frozen.
nonclaims: Classification does not prove pairwise sufficiency.
A repeated motif is not promoted beyond 5x3-k3 without fresh controls.
